attributes.title: Asembia's AXS27 Summit
attributes.summary:
Asembia's AXS27 Summit, the company's yearly specialty pharmacy meeting, runs April 25 to 29, 2027 at the Wynn and Encore hotels on the Las Vegas Strip. Registration was open when we checked.

The audience is broad: specialty pharmacies, manufacturers, health systems, PBMs, health plans and technology vendors. Pharmacists in specialty, health-system or limited-distribution practice make up a key part of the audience.

The home page did not show fees or an ACPE credit statement. Before you count on CE hours, check which sessions carry credit.
